She also emphasizes the importance of discovery calls before accepting an SOW to identify all work needed upfront, though she notes this often adds items to the initial scope. b2df9d0c47.q: How do consultants use sprint-based project management to handle competing client requests and prevent overcommitment?
b2df9d0c47.a: Kelly Jo assigns sprint points to projects and calculates how many points she can complete per week based on meeting time and time needed for reactive emergencies. She builds two-week sprints with prioritized projects, and when new requests come in that bump existing work, those projects move to the next sprint. This approach helps her manage capacity and prevents overcommitment because she knows exactly how many points she can deliver based on her availability.

4021d7cb7b.q: Why do time tracking and invoicing represent the biggest challenges for independent MarTech consultants?
4021d7cb7b.a: Kelly Jo describes having a visceral emotional reaction to logging time, finding it frustrating to track every minute of every day as an independent consultant. She notes this is particularly difficult because she works in fragmented time blocks, jumping between different clients throughout the day rather than dedicating long focused periods to one client. While FreshBooks offers a built-in timer tool, it only works for dedicated chunks of time for one client at a time, which doesn't match her working style.

4f092a91cf.q: What is the key difference in influence and decision-making authority between consulting roles and in-house positions?
4f092a91cf.a: As a consultant, Kelly Jo acts as an influencer rather than a decision-maker, making recommendations that clients can reject even though they hired her for expertise. Companies ultimately make final decisions and she must implement their preferred approach even if she believes it's not the best way. In contrast, when sitting outside the company as a consultant, her different opinions are sometimes more respected and she finds it easier to speak up and be opinionated, whereas as an employee she would often quiet her opinions knowing conflicting business initiatives and directions.
